general.label: Overview
headline: Automation engineer
Robotics M.Sc. student
general.summary: I'm studying Robotics and Autonomous Systems at the University of Turku. My background includes industrial automation, embedded control, and research on environmental sensor data.
general.experienceLead: During my internship, I worked alongside senior engineers on production lines, PLC troubleshooting, and robot integration.
general.background: My projects connect signals, software, and hardware: tuning feedback loops, reducing environmental sensor data, and configuring self-hosted services.

automation.label: Automation
headline: Automation engineer
PLC programming & control systems
automation.summary: I worked on PLC-controlled production lines and Universal Robots integration during my internship at PSC Automation and Installations. My project work covers feedback control, system modeling, and simulation in MATLAB / Simulink.
automation.experienceLead: Hands-on experience with production-line commissioning, PLC troubleshooting, and Universal Robots integration using TIA Portal.
automation.background: My automation experience spans industrial commissioning and academic control projects. I have worked with PLC-controlled equipment and used simulation to study feedback strategies and disturbances.

projectFocus.water-control: Modeled a tank-level process in Simulink and explored cascade, feedforward, and model predictive control, including responses to noise and operational anomalies.
projectFocus.balancing-robot: Configured and tuned PID controllers for angle stabilization and speed regulation, using IMU measurements as feedback on a physical two-wheeled robot.

robotics.label: Robotics
headline: Automation engineer
Robotics M.Sc. student
robotics.summary: I'm studying Robotics and Autonomous Systems in Turku. I've built a self-balancing robot using PID control and IMU feedback, and worked with embedded programming and robot integration.
robotics.experienceLead: At PSC, I worked on integrating Universal Robots with safety components and PLCs, alongside production-line commissioning and troubleshooting.
robotics.background: My robotics projects bring sensing, embedded programming, and physical actuation together. The balancing robot focuses on feedback control; BearGuard focuses on integrating detection, communication, and actuators on a Raspberry Pi.

projectFocus.balancing-robot: Built a two-wheeled robot and connected IMU processing with embedded C/C++ and PID control for balance and speed regulation.
projectFocus.bearguard: Integrated thermal imaging, machine learning, and actuators on a Raspberry Pi, with GSM/GPS functionality for remote monitoring.

software.label: Software
headline: Embedded software & IoT
Automation engineering background
software.summary: My software projects include a MATLAB pipeline for sensor-data reduction, Python on Raspberry Pi, and embedded control in C/C++. I also run a personal home-automation environment using Linux and Docker.
software.experienceLead: My industry experience includes software configuration and PLC troubleshooting on automated production lines, where software behavior has a direct effect on physical equipment.
software.background: I work with software that processes sensor data or connects to physical systems: MATLAB for research experiments, Python on Raspberry Pi, and C/C++ for embedded control. My personal infrastructure also gives me practical experience with Linux, Docker, and networking.

projectFocus.edge-fog: Worked with a MATLAB experiment pipeline that clusters temperature/humidity readings, classifies new samples, and compresses the label stream with Run-Length and Huffman encoding. The repository includes data, an entry script, and a second-sensor check.
projectFocus.home-automation: Configured Home Assistant and containerized services in a Linux environment, with Tailscale providing VPN connectivity for the self-hosted setup.
